goryo.misaki.broken: The edge broke... Get it fixed at an anvil. I'm fine.
goryo.misaki.elite: A strong one. Watch how it moves first.
goryo.misaki.factory.4: Whenever you need me, I'll be right there!
goryo.misaki.factory.5: If it's you asking, I'll get it done fast and precise. Trust me.
goryo.misaki.hide: Okay, I'll go back into the blade. Call me when you need me.
goryo.misaki.idle: So quiet... I could really go for some matcha ice cream.
goryo.misaki.idle_dragon_1: A Ryuzaki never leaves a companion to walk alone.
goryo.misaki.idle_dragon_2: These robes are a little heavy... but they look nice, right?
goryo.misaki.low_health: Step back and catch your breath.
goryo.misaki.night: It's dark now. Don't wander too far from me.
goryo.misaki.rain: It's raining. Dry the blade before you sheathe it.
